Payment & Revenue: Viewing the cart auto-hides any item the caller already owns, silently cleaning it up rather than showing a stale entry.
column3:
1. Log in and add a course to the cart.
2. Enroll in that same course via a separate path (e.g. free enrollment).
3. Prepare and send GET /api/v1/cart.
4. Inspect the returned items and confirm the now-owned course is absent.
column4: 1. The now-owned course is silently absent from the cart response, with no error/notice.
column5: - Logged in; a course in cart that the caller subsequently enrolls in.

column3:
1. Log in and identify a course the caller already owns.
2. Prepare and send POST /api/v1/cart/items body {"courseId":<already enrolled course>}; inspect the response.
3. Add a different course to the cart, then send POST /api/v1/cart/items body {"courseId":<that same course, already in cart>}.

column5: - Logged in; a course already enrolled and a course already in cart.
